name: REST API
summary: Build web scraping into any application.

verification.note: Official API documentation is available. Authenticated requests have not been run in this review.

auth.note: Keep API keys on the server or in your client’s credential store. Usage is charged to your Geonode plan.

use_cases.title: Build with your own stack
use_cases.description: Use standard HTTP requests from a language or platform of your choice.

use_cases.title: Connect a custom service
use_cases.description: Integrate asynchronous extraction and completion webhooks into your service.

A Geonode API key and an active plan for authenticated requests.

troubleshooting.question: My API key is not accepted.
troubleshooting.answer: Check the key in the Geonode dashboard and send it using X-Api-Key. Keep it out of browser bundles, URLs and version control.

troubleshooting.question: The request is rate limited.
troubleshooting.answer: Respect the Retry-After response and your plan’s concurrency limits. Avoid automatically retrying a job submission when its outcome is unknown.
